channel.title: City Record Digest — City Planning
channel.description: NYC City Record notices for City Planning

item.title: HVAC Maintenance Services NAE
item.description:
City Planning | Public Comment on Contract Awards | Notice In plain English (machine-written): The Department of City Planning is seeking public comment on a proposed negotiated contract with Donnelly Mechanical Corp for heating, ventilation and air conditioning maintenance services.

This is a notice that The New York City Department of City Planning  is seeking comments from the public about the proposed contract below.

  

Contract Type: Contract

Contractor:  Donnelly Mechanical Corp

item.title: Notice of Completion for Pemmil West 25th Street Rezoning Draft Environmental Impact Statement (DEIS), CEQR No. 26DCP048K
item.description:
City Planning | Special Materials | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of City Planning has issued a completion notice for the draft environmental impact statement on the proposed Pemmil West 25th Street rezoning, a review of the project's environmental effects.

item.title: City Map and Address Assignment - Document Digitization Project
item.description:
City Planning | Procurement | Award | $100K | Vendor: New York State Industries for the Disabled Inc
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of City Planning awarded New York State Industries for the Disabled Inc a $99,999 contract for document digitization work tied to City Map and address assignment, under a required method that directs the city to use this preferred source.

item.title: 1900 Shore Parkway Rezoning Negative Declaration, CEQR No. 26DCP134K
